Kenny Davern continues to set the standard for jazz clarinet. He currently enjoys a productive relationship with Arbors Records and performs frequently at numerous jazz festivals across the country. Mr. Davern received an honorary doctorate degree from Hamilton College in May of 2000.
Part II was conducted in Clearwater Beach, Florida on March 16, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
